name: The Apothecary's Forgetting
summary: A thread from a companion's past, picked up by someone in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: The Apothecary's Forgetting: something on the train left a thread loose, and it picks up in Wickermoor after the Crooked House.
stages.hint: Finish the Crooked House, then talk to them in Wickermoor.

waits.text: Morgan the apothecary in Wickermoor will take up this thread once the Crooked House is behind us.

stages.journal: Morgan knows the shape of what we forgot.
